<!-- Generated by tools/gen_docs.py from catalog/. Do not edit. -->

| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Operator** `operator` | Reinhard and Devlin | Reinhard and Devlin, Drago, Mantiuk | The tone mapping operator. |
| **Gamma** `gamma` | 2.2 | 0.5 to 4 | OpenCV raises the stretched result to 1 / gamma. OpenCV uses 1. 2.2 is our choice, close to the sRGB curve the input was decoded with. |
| **Intensity** `intensity` | 0 | -8 to 8 | For Reinhard only. The brightness of the result, from -8 to 8. OpenCV uses 0. |
| **Light adaptation** `lightAdapt` | 1 | 0 to 1 | For Reinhard only. 1 adapts to each pixel, 0 to the mean of the image. OpenCV uses 1. |
| **Color adaptation** `colorAdapt` | 0 | 0 to 1 | For Reinhard only. 1 adapts each channel on its own, 0 adapts to the luminance. OpenCV uses 0. |
| **Saturation** `saturation` | 1 | 0 to 2 | For Drago and Mantiuk. The color saturation of the result. OpenCV uses 1. |
| **Bias** `bias` | 0.85 | 0.5 to 1 | For Drago only. The bias b of the adaptive logarithm. The OpenCV documentation says 0.7 to 0.9 usually work best, and OpenCV uses 0.85. |
| **Contrast scale** `scale` | 0.7 | 0.1 to 1 | For Mantiuk only. The factor that the contrast response is multiplied by. OpenCV uses 0.7. |
